inaoe.name: National Institute of Astrophysics, Optics and Electronics
inaoe.description: Public research center in Tonantzintla. It continues the National Astrophysical Observatory founded in 1942. It convenes through its director general, Dr. David Sánchez de la Llave.

sedetra.name: Secretariat of Economic Development and Labor
sedetra.description: Agency of the Government of the State of Puebla. It promotes economic development and labor in the state. In the Manifesto it convenes through its representative, Lic. Marco Antonio Molina Sánchez.

secihti.name: Secretariat of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation of Puebla
secihti.description: Agency of the Government of the State of Puebla. It connects science, the humanities, technology and innovation with academia, government, companies and society. It convenes through its acting head, Mtro. Héctor Guillermo Silva Galindo.

cts.name: Capital of Technology and Sustainability
cts.description: State agency in San José Chiapa, formerly Ciudad Modelo. It is now the Polo de Desarrollo del Bienestar. It convenes through its director general, Mtro. José Antonio Silva Hernández.

upaep.name: Universidad Popular Autónoma del Estado de Puebla
upaep.description: UPAEP stands for Universidad Popular Autónoma del Estado de Puebla, a private university. It is the only one in the state with an aerospace engineering degree.

buap.name: Benemérita Universidad Autónoma de Puebla
buap.description: The state's public university, based in Puebla's historic center. It convenes from academia.

sintonia.name: Sintonía
sintonia.description: Collaborative institute for productivity and the economic development of Puebla, across companies, government, universities and society. Dr. José Pablo Nuño de la Parra presides over it.

sme.name: National Coordination of World Space Week Mexico
sme.description: It coordinates World Space Week in Mexico, from October 4 to 10. Ing. Mario M. Arreola Santander presides over it. In 2026 the international theme was Rocket Revolution.

regenia.name: Network for the Generation of Knowledge and Open Innovation
regenia.description: A national network that connects science communicators, universities, companies, governments and the public to open scientific and technological knowledge. Lic. Denzel Manuel Carrillo Tovar presides over it.

csi.name: Startup and Innovation Cluster, A.C.
csi.description: Civil association that convenes the Manifesto together with the other institutions. Rodrigo Yamil Álvarez Moisés presides over it. Adhesion to the Pact is written to this cluster, with a representative and a contribution, by November 13, 2026.

automotriz.name: Central Zone Automotive Cluster
automotriz.description: The meeting point of the automotive industry in Puebla and Tlaxcala. Mtra. Mónica Doger Ramírez directs it.

canacintra.name: National Chamber of the Transformation Industry in Puebla
canacintra.description: Business chamber of Puebla's industrialists. In the Manifesto it convenes through the vice president of committees, Juan Alberto Vázquez.

yankuilotl.name: Yankuilotl
yankuilotl.description: Majority state-owned company in San Andrés Cholula. It works on semiconductors, mobility and software for Puebla's technology ecosystem. Dr. Argel Vega represents it in the Manifesto.
